title: Ingestion SLA - Collector connector
description: Completion-time rolling one-hour gauges. The exact 60-second fraction drives alerts; p50/p95/p99 use histogram interpolation. No data is unknown, never 100%. Processing-error gauges expose reviewed partial coverage, retry attempts, unique affected paths and recovery separately from the latency population.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, max by (environment, application, milestone, le) (ingestion_sli_window_duration_seconds_bucket{environment="$environment"}))
histogram_quantile(0.95, max by (environment, application, milestone, le) (ingestion_sli_window_duration_seconds_bucket{environment="$environment"}))
histogram_quantile(0.99, max by (environment, application, milestone, le) (ingestion_sli_window_duration_seconds_bucket{environment="$environment"}))

options.content:
These measurements count **observed processing errors**, not confirmed final ingestion failures. Retries are attempts; duplicate telemetry counts once. Affected paths split into recovered and without observed success. Errors after an explicit completion do not revoke success.

Only configured, reviewed boundaries appear below. A configured boundary still has partial coverage; absent errors do not prove complete application success. Engine, Ingress rejection, and Inventory Views error boundaries are currently unconfigured. Missing or stale telemetry is **No data**. Latency attainment above continues to use matched successful completions.

panels.title: Processing error attempts (1h)
panels.description: Distinct reviewed failed processing attempts, deduplicated by ingestion and trace/span identity. SQL/HTTP child errors and post-completion errors are excluded.

targets.expr: max by (environment, application, milestone) (ingestion_sli_window_processing_error_attempts{environment="$environment"}) and on (environment, application, milestone) (max by (environment, application, milestone) (ingestion_sli_error_boundary_enabled{environment="$environment"}) == 1) and on (environment) (time() - max by (environment) (ingestion_sli_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{environment="$environment"}) < 30)

panels.title: Affected ingestion paths (1h)
panels.description: Unique ingestion/application/milestone paths with a qualifying processing error in the last hour, counted once even if retried.

targets.expr: max by (environment, application, milestone) (ingestion_sli_window_processing_error_paths{environment="$environment"}) and on (environment, application, milestone) (max by (environment, application, milestone) (ingestion_sli_error_boundary_enabled{environment="$environment"}) == 1) and on (environment) (time() - max by (environment) (ingestion_sli_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{environment="$environment"}) < 30)

panels.title: Recovered paths with errors (1h)
panels.description: Affected paths with a later authoritative successful completion of the same application and milestone.

targets.expr: max by (environment, application, milestone) (ingestion_sli_window_recovered_error_paths{environment="$environment"}) and on (environment, application, milestone) (max by (environment, application, milestone) (ingestion_sli_error_boundary_enabled{environment="$environment"}) == 1) and on (environment) (time() - max by (environment) (ingestion_sli_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{environment="$environment"}) < 30)

panels.title: Error paths without observed success (1h)
panels.description: Affected paths lacking observed success. These are not proven permanent failures; telemetry may be incomplete.

targets.expr: max by (environment, application, milestone) (ingestion_sli_window_error_paths_without_success{environment="$environment"}) and on (environment, application, milestone) (max by (environment, application, milestone) (ingestion_sli_error_boundary_enabled{environment="$environment"}) == 1) and on (environment) (time() - max by (environment) (ingestion_sli_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{environment="$environment"}) < 30)

panels.title: Post-completion error attempts (1h)
panels.description: Observed processing-boundary ERROR spans ending at or after successful completion. They do not revoke that completion.

targets.expr: max by (environment, application, milestone) (ingestion_sli_window_post_completion_error_attempts{environment="$environment"}) and on (environment, application, milestone) (max by (environment, application, milestone) (ingestion_sli_error_boundary_enabled{environment="$environment"}) == 1) and on (environment) (time() - max by (environment) (ingestion_sli_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{environment="$environment"}) < 30)

panels.title: Paths with post-completion errors (1h)
panels.description: Unique paths with post-completion errors. These may also have earlier recovered errors; do not add them to affected path counts.

targets.expr: max by (environment, application, milestone) (ingestion_sli_window_post_completion_error_paths{environment="$environment"}) and on (environment, application, milestone) (max by (environment, application, milestone) (ingestion_sli_error_boundary_enabled{environment="$environment"}) == 1) and on (environment) (time() - max by (environment) (ingestion_sli_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{environment="$environment"}) < 30)

panels.title: Reviewed error boundaries (configured != complete coverage)
panels.description: A configured rule supports the reviewed boundary only, not every failure path. Unconfigured application/milestone pairs have no error measurement.

targets.expr: max by (environment, application, milestone) (ingestion_sli_error_boundary_enabled{environment="$environment"}) and on (environment) (time() - max by (environment) (ingestion_sli_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{environment="$environment"}) < 30)

panels.title: Errors excluded by correlation problems
panels.description: Retained reviewed error attempts missing a start or having conflicting evidence, host/origin conflicts, or invalid intervals. These remain outside correlated failure counts.

targets.expr: max by (environment, reason) (ingestion_sli_processing_error_correlation_quality{environment="$environment"}) and on (environment) (time() - max by (environment) (ingestion_sli_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{environment="$environment"}) < 30)
